# Preemption checks on GOARCH=wasm fire every 4096 iterations with the
# first check at iteration 4096: a peer counting scheduler wakeups
# observes 0 quanta at 4095 iterations, 1 at 4096, and 2 at 8192.
[!exec:node] skip 'node not in PATH'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=wasip1
env GOARCH=wasm

logos build -o $WORK/exe.wasm .
exec node run.mjs $WORK/exe.wasm
stdout '^q4095 0$'
stdout '^q4096 1$'
stdout '^q8192 2$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/firstcheck

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
	"sync/atomic"
)

var progress atomic.Int64

var sink int

//go:noinline
func spin(n int) {
	s := 0
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		s = s*3 + i
		progress.Store(int64(i))
	}
	progress.Store(int64(n))
	sink = s
}

//go:noinline
func quanta(n int) int {
	done := make(chan struct{})
	res := make(chan int, 1)
	go func() {
		q := 0
		for {
			select {
			case <-done:
				res <- q
				return
			default:
				runtime.Gosched()
				q++
			}
		}
	}()
	spin(n)
	close(done)
	return <-res
}

func main() {
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(1)
	fmt.Println("q4095", quanta(4095))
	fmt.Println("q4096", quanta(4096))
	fmt.Println("q8192", quanta(8192))
}

-- run.mjs --
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { WASI } from 'node:wasi';

const wasi = new WASI({ version: 'preview1', args: [], env: {}, returnOnExit: true });
const mod = await WebAssembly.compile(readFileSync(process.argv[2]));
const inst = await WebAssembly.instantiate(mod, wasi.getImportObject());
process.exitCode = wasi.start(inst);
